quickDive.missionR: You were the first to walk into the generator shed, tools in hand, pulling open the panel to find the cause. During repairs you took on the hardest part by hand. For you, doing and understanding have never been separate things.
quickDive.missionI: You spent the longest time in the archive room, connecting decades of records into a single thread. Analyzing the stream samples, you wrote out your full reasoning. Understanding alone isn't enough — you need it to become something tangible.
quickDive.missionA: Designing the last evening's event, you considered space and flow for every segment. Your personal presentation used a form no one expected. Your imagination isn't idle dreaming — it carries the execution to make ideas real.
quickDive.missionS: On the mountain trail at night, you sat with Kai, saying nothing, just being there. On the fourth day, you walked over to Nora. You help through action, not words. Your care isn't comforting phrases; it's problem-solving hands.
quickDive.missionE: Planning the last 36 hours, you stood up and drew the action chart. Negotiating with the village, you laid out the terms clearly. Your leadership isn't verbal — it's imprinted on everything you've done.
quickDive.missionC: You completed Ruth's safety checklist item by item. Analyzing five days of data, you found three improvable patterns. Archiving records, every document was dated and categorized. You pursue the perfect balance between efficiency and quality.

narrativeExplore.title: That Card
narrativeExplore.subtitle: Thirty trials. Your real choices will reveal a clearer side of you.
narrativeExplore.envelopeText: You don't remember putting it in your pocket.
narrativeExplore.invitationBody: You have been included in the participant list for Game Zero.
narrativeExplore.rulesSubtitle: Before you walk through that door, you need to know this
narrativeExplore.charactersSubtitle: When you walked through the door, five people were already in the hall
narrativeExplore.companionBeat_marcus: Marcus is already crouched near the workbench. He glances up — once.
narrativeExplore.companionBeat_mia: Mia traces a pipe joint with her index finger. She hasn't said a word yet.
narrativeExplore.companionBeat_kai: Kai has stopped sketching. His pencil hovers above the page.
narrativeExplore.companionBeat_leila: Leila has stepped into the crowd. She turns her head when you walk in.
narrativeExplore.companionBeat_adrian: Adrian is already running numbers under his breath. He pauses to watch you.
narrativeExplore.companionBeat_nora: Nora hasn't looked up from her notebook. But the page has gone still.
narrativeExplore.chapterFarewell_mechanical: Marcus wipes his hands on his coat and walks past you. "You held your ground."
narrativeExplore.chapterFarewell_laboratory: Mia closes the lab notebook. "You read the room differently than I did. That's useful."
narrativeExplore.chapterFarewell_theater: Kai tucks his sketchbook under his arm. "You stayed with the choice. Not many do."
narrativeExplore.chapterFarewell_waiting: Leila lingers behind. "What you did here — the room remembers."
narrativeExplore.chapterFarewell_negotiation: Adrian looks at you, then at the door. "You bargained without losing yourself. Rare."
narrativeExplore.chapterFarewell_archive: Nora sets her notebook down for the first time. She nods, once.
